ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sparr shows you sparring partners near you and checks your location when you publish, join or check in. It is not shown to others.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sparr uses your photos to send pictures in the sparring chat.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sparr uses the camera to scan fighter profile QR codes and sparring check-in codes.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Sparr uses this permission to measure which TikTok ads lead to downloads and subscriptions. Your sparring data is not shared.
